senses.gloss: m. ch. (v. כִּיתַּן) = h. כֻּתּוֹנֶת, linen coat, in gen. undergarment, shirt.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 37:3">Targ. O. Gen. XXXVII, 3</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 27b:6">R. Hash. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>דהפכיה ככ׳</he> that he turned it like a shirt (the inside outside).

<cite ref="Chullin 46a:12">Ḥull. 46ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="F00084"><he>וְרַד</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>כִּיתּוּנִין</he>, <cite ref="K00648"><he>כִּיתּוּנַיָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00646"><he>כִּתּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 3:22">Targ. Is. III, 22</cite>; a. fr.
